alerts.headline: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Monday, Nov. 16 to 5 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 19, the northbound Interstate 405 off-ramp to Southeast Eighth Street will close for utilities work. Southeast Eighth Street near the Old Wilburton Tunnel area will have detours with flaggers.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from Bellevue Way Southeast will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting 
the night of Sunday, Nov. 15 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 20. A signed detour will be in place.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 8 a.m., 
starting the night of Saturday, Nov. 14 to the morning of Sunday, Nov. 15. A signed detour will be in 
place
The southbound SR 527 on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be close from 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 13 to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov 16.

Sound Transit contractor crews will close several lanes on eastbound and westbound SR 522 between 96th Avenue Northeast and Northeast 180th Street from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Nov. 16 through Wednesday, Nov. 25. The right and left lanes will not close at the same time.

Up to two lanes of southbound SR 527 between 214th Street Southeast and I-405 will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 13 to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov 16. Ramp traffic will be detoured south to Northeast 195th Street (exit 24) to northbound I-405. Crews will implement a rolling slowdown in both directions of SR 527, with traffic stopped up to 15 minutes, at 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 13 and 3 a.m. Monday, Nov. 16.

From 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Monday through Friday starting Nov. 9, intermittent single-lane closures will happen on SR 203 near NE Carnation Farm Road for guardrail work. Flaggers will alternate traffic through the work zone. 

Work is scheduled in this area for up to two weeks.

From 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Monday through Friday starting Nov. 9, intermittent single-lane closures will happen on SR 203 near 324th Way NE for guardrail work. Flaggers will alternate traffic through the work zone. 

Work is scheduled in this area for up to two weeks. Some work is weather dependent.

Nightly from 11:59 p.m. to 4 a.m. the next day beginning Tuesday, Nov. 17 to 4 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 19, expect rolling slowdowns on both directions of Interstate 90 from Front Street/228th Avenue Southeast (milepost 17) to State Route 202/Bendigo Boulevard (milepost 30) for utilities work.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.

Sound Transit contractor crews will close the two right lanes on northbound and southbound SR 522 from Northeast 175th Street to SR 522 near 68th Avenue Northeast from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m. nightly Monday, Nov. 16 through the morning of Friday, Nov. 20.
Sound Transit contractor crews will close the right lane on westbound SR 522 at 73rd Avenue Northeast daily and nightly through the next several weeks.

Sound Transit contractor crews will close several lanes on eastbound and westbound SR 522 between 61st Avenue Northeast and 73rd Avenue Northeast from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Nov. 16 through the afternoon of Wednesday, Nov. 25.
Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 between milepost 18.11 and milepost 16.45 will close overnight from 10 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 14- 7 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of southbound I-405 between milepost 19.84 and milepost 18.11 will close overnight from 10:30 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 14 – 8 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of northbound I-405 between milepost 18.3 and milepost 19.85 will close overnight from 11 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 14- 8:30 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15.

Sound Transit contractor crews will close the left lane on eastbound Northeast 145th Street between 28th Avenue Northeast and 30th Avenue Northeast from 7 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Nov. 16 through the afternoon of Wednesday, Nov. 25.

Sound Transit contractor crews will close the right lane on eastbound Northeast 145th Street between 15th Avenue Northeast and 17th Avenue Northeast from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily Friday, Nov. 13 through the evening of Wednesday, Nov. 25.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the right lane of eastbound I-90 will close between East Mercer Way and I-405 for construction. Delays are possible through the work zone.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 ramps to northbound and southbound I-405 will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.
From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from East Mercer Way will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

The North Southport Drive on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. – 8 a.m., 
starting the night of Saturday, Nov. 14 to the morning of Sunday, Nov. 15. A signed detour will be in 
place.

The North Southport Drive on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9:30 p.m. – 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Sunday, Nov. 15 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 20. A signed detour will be in place.

From 6 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 14 and Sunday, Nov. 15, one lane of the southbound State Route 99 First Avenue Bridge (milepost 27-26) will close for maintenance. The right lane of the bridge will close on Saturday and the left lane HOV lane will close on Sunday.

The I-5 express lanes will be reduced to two lanes across the Ship Canal Bridge beginning at 7 p.m. nightly from Monday. Nov. 16, to Thursday, Nov. 19. 

The express lanes will close at 9 p.m., two hours earlier than normal, each night from Monday, Nov. 16, to Wednesday, Nov. 17.
The southbound I-5 off-ramp to Mercer Street will be closed from 10 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 17, to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 18, and from 10 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 18, to 5 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 19.
The Northeast 45th Street on-ramp to southbound I-5 will be closed from 10 p.m. Monday, Nov. 16, to 5 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 17.

The southbound I-5 off-ramp to Boylston Avenue East will be closed from 9 p.m. Monday, Nov. 16, to 5 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 17. 

The Boylston Avenue East on-ramp to southbound I-5 will be closed from 9 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 17, to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 18, and from 9 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 18, to 5 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 19.
Southbound I-5 will be reduced to two lanes between Northeast Ravenna Boulevard and Yesler Way between 11:30 p.m. and 5 a.m. nightly from Monday, Nov. 16, to Thursday, Nov. 19.
On I-5 southbound just south of SR 104 (MP 176) there is a collision blocking the HOV lane.  The State Patrol has arrived on the scene.
Update 1:14 AM : On I-5 northbound just north of NE 145th St (MP 176) there is a collision blocking the HOV lane.  The State Patrol has arrived on the scene.

From 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Monday through Friday starting Nov. 9, intermittent single-lane closures will happen on SR 202 near SE Fish Hatchery Road for guardrail work. Flaggers will alternate traffic through the work zone. 

Work is scheduled in this area for up to two weeks. Some work is weather dependent.

Daily (except Friday, weekends) until further notice from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. beginning Monday, Nov. 16, one right lane of southbound Interstate 5 from 47th Street Southeast to State Route 526/SR 527 (mileposts 191-189) will close for Sound Transit work. The right lane of the southbound I-5 off-ramp to 41st Street and the right lane of the southbound I-5 on-ramp from Broadway will also close.
From 7 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Monday, Nov. 16, the right lane of northbound State Route 529 over the Snohomish River Bridge (milepost 3) will close for maintenance.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.
From 9:30 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 17 and 4 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 18, US 2 traffic will alternate with flaggers near Sultan Startup Road (milepost 24) for maintenance.
